label: Gold Leaf
blurb: Gilds part of the picture the way an icon or a manuscript is gilded: squares of beaten gold leaf laid in overlapping rows over red bole, each sheet sitting at its own slight angle so it catches the light differently from its neighbours, with fine wrinkles and creases from being pressed down, a raised lip where one sheet overlaps the next and small losses where the leaf has worn through to the red clay. The gold reflects the light of the picture around it, Light swings the burnished sheen across the sheets, and the rest of the picture is left as warm matte paint with a dark painted line along the edge of the gold.
